1.title: A surface code patch
1.intro: Nine physical qubits in a 3 by 3 grid hold one logical qubit. An encoder spreads |0> over all nine, and eight checks (four X, four Z) watch for errors. Pick an error next to the Play button to see which checks fire.

2.title: Logical CNOT between two patches
2.intro: Both patches use the encoder from lesson 1: A becomes |+>_L, B becomes |0>_L. Nine physical CNOTs, one between each pair of matching qubits, then act as one logical CNOT and leave a logical Bell pair.

3.title: Preparing a T state
3.intro: H and T on q0 make the T state on one physical qubit; the encoder from lesson 1 carries it over as |T>_L. It is read in X (and Y): ideally 1 comes up in 14.6% of shots.

4.title: Teleporting the T state
4.intro: Patch A holds |T>_L (lesson 3), B and C become a logical Bell pair (lesson 2), then a logical CNOT A to B and the readouts of A in X and B in Z teleport the T state to C, up to a Pauli fix applied to the measured bits.
